column1: # Weights of the method: the model and effort of each kind of work.
# Columns, separated by a tab: weight, model, effort. Edit the model and effort
# to fit the plan of the account; scripts/weights.sh reads this file. The
# defaults run on a plan that only has sonnet at low or medium effort.
# light: text, docs, small or mechanical change. medium: common feature, bug
# with a known cause. strong: architecture, security, payment, migration, repo
# permissions, bug without a clear cause. reviewer: the close-reviewer agent.
